_comment: The kinds of data that flow between nodes. A port is a type plus facets; an edge is legal when the producer's facets satisfy every facet the consumer names. Facets are what make two outputs that look alike (a depth map is a depth map) actually interchangeable -- or not: disparity never flows silently into a metric port. Every value also carries its source image id, so outputs from the same photo can be aligned. Engine and app both read this file; nothing retypes it.

Image.doc: A photo or a rendered or synthesised picture. sRGB, 8-bit.

Mask.doc: Per-pixel selection, aligned to a source image.

Depth.doc: Per-pixel depth. kind says what the numbers mean; measure says along which direction.

PointMap.doc: Per-pixel 3D points, H x W x 3, in OpenCV axes (x right, y down, z forward) for the camera frame.

Camera.doc: Intrinsics for one image, and optionally a pose (world_from_camera, OpenCV axes).

Normals.doc: Per-pixel unit normals. The frame is never implicit.

Confidence.doc: Per-pixel confidence. What the numbers mean differs by model, so it is stated.

Mesh.doc: A triangle or quad mesh, GLB on disk.

GaussianSplat.doc: 3D Gaussians, Inria-layout float32 PLY on disk (raw values: log scales, logit opacity, wxyz rotations).

Pose.doc: Rotation, translation and scale placing one asset in a scene frame.

CameraPath.doc: Cameras over time, for rendering and view synthesis.

ViewSet.doc: Several views of one subject, each with a Camera and provenance (which model made it, with what seed).

Clicks.doc: Points and boxes a person placed on an image, in pixels, with positive or negative labels.

Scene.doc: A set of posed assets and a background, from one source photo.

Metric.doc: Numbers an evaluation node measured, with their names and units.
